name: Tofu Ads
description:
Tofu Ads is an AI ad creative builder for producing and revising on-brand advertising assets for B2B marketing teams. Create LinkedIn single-image ads, LinkedIn carousel ads, and multi-size Google Display banner ads from a landing page, website URL, creative brief, or campaign idea.

Once you connect, ask Claude to do the following:
• “Learn my brand from [website URL], then create a LinkedIn single-image ad aimed at [audience] that promotes [offer].”
• “Turn [landing page URL] into a LinkedIn carousel ad that explains [product or idea] through a clear, engaging story.”
• “Create a complete set of Google Display banner ads for [website URL] promoting [campaign or offer]. Keep every size visually consistent and on-brand.”
• “Revise the ad you just created. Make the headline more direct, reduce the amount of text, and give the visual a more premium look.”

Use your Brand Library, including brand voice, colors, fonts, logos, and imagery, or extract a new brand profile from a public website. 

Tofu returns ad copy, image previews, downloadable assets, and editor links. Google Display sets are generated as visually consistent, upload-ready PNGs across all supported dimensions.

Revise creatives with natural-language instructions, update an individual carousel card or display size, browse past creatives, compare and restore versions, and reopen or delete previous work.

Designed for AI ad generation, paid social creative, LinkedIn advertising, carousel design, Google Display ads, banner ads, creative production, brand consistency, and ad variations.

Use our platform to continuously optimize your existing ad campaigns on Linkedin and Google.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Tofu Ads to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Tofu Ads to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://ads.tofuhq.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Tofu Ads MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Tofu Ads lists 13 MCP tools, including create_google_display_ads, create_linkedin_carousel_ad, create_linkedin_single_image_ad, delete_creative, extract_brand_from_website, get_brand_profile, get_capabilities, get_creative_generation_status, list_creative_versions, list_creatives, restore_creative_version, and revise_creative.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Tofu Ads?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Tofu Ads in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.

_published_faq.name: Does Tofu Ads MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Tofu Ads requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Tofu Ads is developed by Tofu. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
